voygr-tech-placecall-placecall.description: Use when the user wants to phone a US business, or several, to book, reschedule or cancel a table or appointment; to ask about hours, prices, stock, availability or a policy; to get a quote; to follow up on an order; or to confirm details. Also use it when there is no number yet ("find a florist and call them"), or when the call must get through a phone menu, hold or transfer. Places real calls and returns a verified outcome and the full transcript. First 250 calls free.
voygr-tech-placecall-placecall.author: voygr-tech

voygr-tech-placecall-claude-directory-pl.description: Find US businesses and place real phone calls through the PlaceCall MCP server, then report the verified result and transcript.
